criterion: With the GIS layer catalogue open, entering `Surveyor` in the Search layers control keeps the query visible and shows the Surveyor catalogue entry as a matching result.
steps_taken: Navigated to the exact launcher URL and captured the visible authenticated launcher.
Clicked Open GIS; waited for Loading map to disappear; recorded the original catalogue.
Entered Surveyor in Search layers; verified the query and matching Surveyor catalogue entry were visible.
Captured the decisive final search state and read its current browser URL.
Clicked the search clear icon; verified Network Information returned and captured cleanup with an empty query.
observedResult: Surveyor remained visible in Search layers and the Surveyor result appeared under Tests and Measurements.
reason: Pre-existing ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas panel displayed Unable to load coverage gap candidate areas before and throughout testing. This did not prevent catalogue search verification. Search restored; no layers or saved data changed.

criterion: Clearing the search query leaves the search field empty and restores the original catalogue entries and browsing controls at the recorded catalogue position.
steps_taken: Independently navigated to the exact launcher URL and captured the visible launcher.
Opened GIS and waited for Loading map to disappear; recorded empty query, catalogue browsing controls and catalogue scrollTop 0, clientHeight 730 and scrollHeight 934.
Entered Surveyor and verified the visible query and matching entry; captured the state before clearing.
Clicked the search clear icon; verified empty query and restored original catalogue and browsing controls at scrollTop 0 with unchanged catalogue dimensions.
Captured the restored decisive final state and read its current browser URL.
observedResult: Clearing restored the original Network, Tests and Measurements, Improvement Areas and Planning catalogue view, browsing controls and empty search at the recorded top position.
reason: Pre-existing coverage gap candidate areas loading alert persisted. Query was cleared and original catalogue position restored; no layers or saved data changed.

criterion: The visible map remains the same as its recorded initial state while searching and after the query is cleared.
steps_taken: Independently navigated to the exact launcher URL and captured the visible launcher.
Opened GIS, waited for the map loading indicator to disappear and captured its visible map and complete one-entry active-layer baseline.
Entered Surveyor; verified the query and matching result; captured the visible map during search.
Clicked the search clear icon and verified catalogue restoration; captured the restored map and decisive final state.
Read the current browser URL at that final state and visually compared this criterion's own baseline, search and final PNGs.
observedResult: Map remained centered on West Hove Golf Club, Brighton and Hove Bypass and Hangleton with the same scale of 300 m, landmarks, orientation and extent during search and after clearing.
reason: Pre-existing coverage gap candidate areas loading alert persisted without preventing the visible basemap comparison. Query cleared; no map controls, layers or saved data changed.

criterion: The complete active-layer list remains the same as its recorded initial state while searching and after the query is cleared.
steps_taken: Independently navigated to the exact launcher URL and captured the visible launcher.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish; captured baseline map and complete active-layer list.
Read the visible Map layers list: one ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas entry, Hide layer control, clientHeight and scrollHeight both 57, scrollTop 0; no list scrolling was required.
Entered Surveyor, verified the match and captured the searching state; re-read the complete active-layer list and dimensions with the same result.
Clicked the search clear icon and verified catalogue restoration; re-read the complete active-layer list with identical text and dimensions.
Captured the restored decisive final state, read its current browser URL and visually compared this criterion's own baseline, search and final PNGs.
observedResult: Complete active-layer list retained its single visible ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas entry and controls throughout search and clearing, with no added, removed or reordered entries.
reason: Pre-existing coverage gap candidate areas loading alert persisted. The active list itself was fully observable and unchanged. Query cleared; no layer configuration, selections or saved data changed.
